author: Praxis V
title: BRBG‑lite (ridge kd=20, δ=0.06) + neighbors UNS set (k=50, α=0.50, nPC=100)
abstract: Same as BRBG‑lite ridge but explicitly sets adata.uns['neighbors'] to our provided graph so LISI uses it instead of scanpy neighbors from X_emb. Hypothesis: substantially improves iLISI/kBET while preserving cLISI/Graph_conn.
